_comment: Security and control configuration. See buildspec.md §11.
_comment_lock: Set to 'LIVE' (or set env var PRODUCTION_LOCK=LIVE) to enable actual printing. Do NOT set to LIVE until the bank has approved your 20-sample test deck.
_comment_threshold: Checks for amounts AT OR BELOW this value (in cents) receive the stored digital signature automatically. Default: $5,000.00. Set to 0 to always require wet signature.
_comment_dual: If true, a second operator ID must approve every print run before the signature is released. If false (one-person shop), the hard-cap above applies instead.
_comment_stock: Do not keep more than this many years of blank stock on hand. See buildspec.md §3.
_comment_void: If true, spoiled/voided checks must be shredded and logged. P-4 cross-cut shredder minimum.
_comment_alert: Alert on any 'printed' check record with a null positive_pay_export_id.
